state.goal: Choose storage for a local Python CLI with 10,000 records and transactional multi-record updates
state.question: Which storage best fits the stated environment and query workload?
known_constraints: The core database software must have no mandatory license fee; hosting and support are excluded.
evidence: Scenario premise: single-user CLI; indexed filtering and atomic multi-record updates are preferred.
Product capability facts are checked in evidence_records.

alternatives.name: SQLite
alternatives.description: Embedded SQLite for a local Python CLI, using SQL queries and transactions.

alternatives.name: Local PostgreSQL
alternatives.description: A PostgreSQL server running on the same machine as the client.

evidence_records.fact: The SQLite core is public domain and its use does not require a software license; optional support or warranty purchases are outside this constraint.
The PostgreSQL license permits software use and distribution without a fee; hosting and support costs are outside this constraint.

hard_constraints.description: The core database software must have no mandatory license fee; hosting and support are excluded.
